searchText: It's effectively impossible to do this, at least not that way If we are going to implement a vote like this we need to do it at the duty time level, the VC requests for PTC attestations to sign and it may get many different ones for different keys So the beacon must track on each slot all blocks it's seen And for a given slot when the VC asks it should send a list of expected Payloads, payload statuses and validator IDs that need to sign Otherwise effectively any non finalized root is a possible dependent root that means a vc would need to query the bn for payload attestation data at every slot. right now i believe most vcs would only query the bn for that data if they have a ptc duty for that slot. the ptc duty endpoint would be effectively useless with this change i think? unless you trigger the vc to go into this mode only during non-finality i guess we would get rid of duties tracking on vc and always send all validator indices, but that also means you can't send out ptc attestations eagerly, you always have to wait until the deadline but that seems simpler than tracking duties for different branches, we don't even have a mechanism right now that would work to handle reorgs of duties due to dependent root changes on non-canonical branches i think you you could still send out eagerly, you'd just need to do another round at the deadline we could do that, but that means several calls per slot and then beacon node needs to be aware of the deadline and only create attestations for present/available payloads before the deadline not for non-canonical blocks. I won' t dig the original discussion that probably I won' t find here, but the only thing that I think works for eager attestations is: - The VC polls every slot on events for head, payload and deadlines tickers for duties. - The BN gives out early on payload arrival + DA check a PTC attestation **only** in two scenarios 1. The validator index it' s tracking is not a PTC member in this slot in mutliple shufflings it' s tracking or 2. The incoming payload is in the canonical shuffling, even if the validator is supposed to attest on multiple shufflings this slot. - The BN also gives out PTC attestations at the deadline to cover the missed cases from above. But it does not give move than one attestation per validator index in the same slot. I believe this should be pretty low priority now and we should focus on getting stable devnets before, and test actual behavior that we need to be testing and will happen in mainnet: reorg late payloads, reorg unavailable payloads, reorg late blocks, etc.
